font_family.label: Dial font
font_family.description: Font for the numbers on the bar and panel dials. Leave empty to use the shell font.

dial_size.label: Bar dial size
dial_size.description: Size of the dial on the bar in pixels. 27 fits the default bar; match it to your bar thickness.

widget.tooltip_idle: Left click: shut down in {time}. Scroll: change the time. Middle click: open the dial

panel.hint_idle: Drag the knob, scroll over the dial or type the time
panel.hint_active: Counting down. Cancel to keep the computer on
panel.hint_invalid: Enter a time from 0:01 to 23:59 using digits only

notify.title: Sleep Timer
notify.started_body: The computer will shut down in {time}, at {clock}
notify.cancelled_body: The computer will not shut down
